description:
Rachel Pringle has spent over 15 years teaching women to reconnect with parts of themselves they were told were too much, too powerful, too dangerous to keep.

This week on YMYR she joins me to talk about what it actually costs a woman to cut herself off from her own power, what becomes possible when she finally stops, and the one thing she believes every woman can do today to begin that journey entirely on her own terms.

Comment RACHEL and I'll send you the full conversation.
